title: Test declarations and callbacks are represented as manifest names
observed_need: Declare named tests, suites, fixtures, parameterized cases, and test metadata without a parallel host registry.
current_language_behavior: The current profile has ordinary functions, bounded sequences, and imports, but no first-class test declaration or first-class handler/closure value for dynamic registration.
why_insufficient: The manifest must name functions and the native suite must build a static sequence; setup/teardown and dynamic parameterized registration cannot yet be idiomatic values.
minimal_reproducer: mncs-test.toml lists entry = 'test_arithmetic'; tests/self_suite.mncs calls test_arithmetic() explicitly in summarize<6>([...]).
desired_direction: A native test declaration/metadata vocabulary and first-class callable/fixture abstraction that remains bounded, typed, and statically inspectable.
workaround: Manifest identities and static MNCS calls make the boundary explicit; no host callback registry is synthesized.
